title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
grouping: Three zones left to right. Left: training-data sources as beige rounded boxes - a large 'π dataset' box of cut-out robot pictures above two smaller boxes 'Internet pre-training' (globe and document icons) and 'OXE' (a globe with coloured stripes) - gathered by a tall right square bracket whose arrow points into the model. Middle: the model as two backbone bars - 'pre-trained VLM' and 'action expert' - each laid across a row of token columns; the action expert's columns sit in a beige panel. Right: a mirrored left square bracket fans out to three stacked beige boxes, each a robot photo with its embodiment name ('14 DoF Bimanual Manipulators', '18 DoF Mobile Manipulators', '7 and 8 DoF Single Arm Manipulators').
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles, all text in a monospace typewriter face. VLM token columns are steel-teal rounded columns with white pill tokens above and below a long white rounded bar ('pre-trained VLM' with grey 'SigLIP (400M) + Gemma (2.6B)'); three teal 'ViT' trapezoids stand on three camera photos (one base view, two wrist views), and the fourth column takes the quoted command '"fold shirt"'. Action-expert columns are pale green with green-outlined pills; inputs q_t and 'noise' enter from below; dashed loop arrows inside each action column show repeated refinement, and outputs a_t, a_t+1, ..., a_t+H sit in a curly brace at the top.
proposed_highlight: Colour separates the two parts of the proposed model (teal VLM, green action expert) and parameter counts in grey under each name state their sizes; the data and robot zones on the sides are beige, so the model reads as the centre between them.
lesson: Bracket the many training-data sources into the model on the left and fan the model out with a mirrored bracket to the robot embodiments it controls on the right, so the figure reads as many datasets -> one policy -> many robots.
notes: Venue not verified (remembered as RSS 2025; Semantic Scholar not queried for this title because of rate limits): venue written as arXiv, year = arXiv preprint year (2410.24164). Photos and robot pictures are embedded rasters.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
